subject.title: Memory dreaming run pegs the gateway event loop for ~10 min until killed; short-term recall store can never persist (2026.6.9, reproduces on unmodified dist)

question: Should maintainers collect the reporter's process samples and run a live current-main reproduction before authorizing a fix PR for the memory dreaming rebuild hang?
rationale: The issue is credible and release-reproduced, but the code path still has several possible hot spots; choosing a fix without the samples risks optimizing the wrong memory-core state or phase path.

options.title: Collect samples first
options.body: Ask for the three process samples plus corpus/config shape, then choose the smallest bounded state or phase repair from that evidence.

options.title: Start exploratory fix now
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned investigation branch to instrument the managed dreaming run and prove the hot path before changing behavior.

options.title: Fold into interrupted-run work
options.body: Handle only the observability/recovery part through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97692 and keep this issue open for the availability bug.

recommendation.title: Collect samples first
recommendation.body: Ask for the three process samples plus corpus/config shape, then choose the smallest bounded state or phase repair from that evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership and adjacent memory-core/gateway work make this the best available routing owner for the proof decision.
